nonClosureRule: A bounded implementation may advance status but must not delete source text, erase remaining obligations, or claim the whole idea from a proxy.

obligations.invariant: No release or proxy may be called the complete Bubble universe while a recorded reasonable consequence remains unrealizable.
remainingLimits: The completeness frontier and the closure rule for newly derived reasonable concepts remain open.
obligations.reopenCondition: Always live until the author accepts a complete connected realization and its derivation ledger.

obligations.invariant: Change, reversibility, recurrence, causal order, and irreversible history remain distinct without a mandatory scalar clock.
remainingLimits: Exact closure-lasso recurrence and lifecycle history direction exist without a universal clock, but duration, metric time, concurrency, general coinduction, and cross-world synchronization remain open.
obligations.reopenCondition: Reopen for every world law requiring concurrency, duration, metric time, general cycles, or cross-bubble order.

obligations.invariant: World continuation follows from one coupled lawful structure and never from a hidden host selector or an unrelated menu of regimes.
remainingLimits: Observer-independent structures now persist, branch, actualize and cease, cross exact typed membranes, and generate recursively branch-indexed connected lineage-relative world slices whose anchors, channel seas, condition transport, inherited complete executable schema-graph revisions, child-local responses, realized-state constructor reactivation, and bounded exact persistent recurrence have no host selector. Intensional schema/formal-family generation, constructor/schema-incidence transformation, topology-changing or non-periodic generated persistence, lawful branch equivalence/convergence, global sea operators, and complete universe generation remain open.
obligations.reopenCondition: Remains open through every stronger self-generated continuation seam until the whole connected universe is realized.

obligations.invariant: A Bubble can lawfully generate its own connected internal whole without the host inventing missing world semantics.
remainingLimits: An intensional recursive constructor now generates a demanded connected family of world instances, lineage, anchors, multi-channel sea relations, exact payload transport, inherited content-addressed complete executable schema graphs, recursively closed pre-instantiation graph replacement, typed law morphisms, and local responses without a host world catalog. Realized local state can reactivate a dormant constructor across bounded causal-generation closures, every plural causal result recursively continues as a complete branch-indexed universe family, and exact active recurrence can close under lineage/revision/anchor identity plus monotone evidence. Intensional graph/formal-family generation, constructor/schema-incidence transformation, topology-changing or non-periodic persistence, and lawful branch convergence remain open, and successor implementation generation remains deferred.
obligations.reopenCondition: Remains open through every partial self-generation slice.

obligations.invariant: Bubble realizes deeper lawful identity, persistence, relation, memory, boundary, and causal organization without installing human-scale labels such as being, protagonist, story, relationship, or life as primitive ontology or release targets.
remainingLimits: The public core is now mechanically separated from historical narrative and teleonomic interpretations, but human-scale terminology remains in immutable release records and compatibility module paths. Every future generated class still needs the same necessity audit.
obligations.reopenCondition: Reopen whenever a human-scale label is proposed as a primitive, privileged derived class, release target, or universal acceptance criterion.

obligations.concept: objective World Will and anchor-mediated intervention
obligations.invariant: World Will acts under explicit objective and constraint structure, and any cross-world intervention is carried by an anchor with identity and causal provenance.
remainingLimits: World Will executes exact bounded optimization through active local anchors and cannot write protected structure or invoke lifecycle. Bounded v0.5.7 preserves one exact crossing; bounded v0.5.8 derives simultaneous exact non-chaining transfer frontiers, generated relation transport with receiver-local response, and exact generated recurrence identity while World Will is disabled. Repeated post-generation crossings, transformations, general conservation, and a full identity calculus remain open.
obligations.reopenCondition: Remains open until anchor-cut and World-Will-disabled counterfactuals discriminate the mechanisms.

obligations.invariant: Positive and negative seas materially alter world viability, continuity, and intervention conditions without becoming moral labels or decorative scores.
remainingLimits: Exact local negative-sea admission causes erosion and restoration, cessation retains residue, membrane crossings leave material accounting, and bounded v0.5.8 preserves multiple named positive/negative sea channels whose sibling relation actions add commutatively. The legacy causal adapter still projects those channels into one scalar viability coordinate. Global structural sea operators, conservation, continuous membrane dynamics, and general placement/growth remain open.
obligations.reopenCondition: Reopen from the first concrete global transport, cross-world membrane, or positive-sea placement law.

obligations.invariant: Natural language preserves intent but executable truth is a typed formal object able to denote unbounded and infinite-dimensional structures without eager enumeration.
remainingLimits: The kernel covers exact countable index products, guarded natural recursion, state-bound queries, strict authored lifecycle and connected-universe lowering, exact typed transport, and a finite polynomial-coalgebra-style constructor law with preserved open frontiers. It does not yet cover uncountable domains, general coinductive streams, symbolic limits, integration, endogenous generation of new intensional family/schema definitions, or a portable BIR.
obligations.reopenCondition: Reopen whenever a required Bubble object cannot be denoted or queried without opaque host behavior.

obligations.invariant: The meaning of the unique or core world and its anchor relation must remain explicit; no implementation may silently install one privileged absolute original.
remainingLimits: Lineage-relative addressing exists, but the intended topology of 고유 세계 remains an author question.
obligations.reopenCondition: Must be resolved with the author before a root-world hierarchy becomes executable semantics.

obligations.invariant: A future Bubble may generate modules, a successor form of itself, and executable formal code only with preserved semantics, provenance, verification, and resource boundaries.
remainingLimits: Current Bubble can stage artifacts, grammar descriptions, and bounded internal causal events but cannot generate, verify, rebuild, or execute a successor implementation of itself.
obligations.reopenCondition: Reopen only after every prior obligation is realized and the author explicitly accepts the current Bubble universe as complete.

obligations.invariant: The universal Bubble core is observer-independent world structure rather than a mandatory plot, agent, life, or other human-scale schema; such names may remain optional interpretations but never completion obligations.
remainingLimits: The observer-independent substrate now generates recursively branch-indexed connected families of lineage-relative worlds, identity/relation anchors, distinct sea channels, exact relation transport, inherited complete executable world-local schema graphs, local continuation, state-reactivated constructor closure, and bounded exact identity-preserving recurrence in addition to prior persistence, branching, and lifecycle evidence. Intensional schema/formal-family generation, constructor/schema-incidence transformation, topology-changing or non-periodic persistence, lawful branch equivalence/convergence, general coinduction, global sea operators, and whole-universe generation remain open.
obligations.reopenCondition: Reopen at every proposed core primitive and at the first internally generated dynamic world structure or wider connected-world structure beyond the accepted evidence contract.

obligations.concept: trans-Turing world semantics and computability provenance
obligations.invariant: Bubble must distinguish effective host computation, intensional or axiomatic world denotation, internal causal accessibility, oracle-relative computation, limit-derived semantics, and physical substrate assumptions; no runtime feature may claim non-Turing power without typed provenance for the extra computational resource.
remainingLimits: The current runtime has exact computable rational values, countable intensional families, guarded natural recursion, finite causal closure, and finite endogenous branching. It has no typed oracle, computability degree, ordinal limit transition, non-computable exact continuum source, physical hypercomputation contract, or provenance-aware replay distinction for non-effective results.
obligations.reopenCondition: Reopen through Q-026 only after a formal comparison identifies where additional computational strength enters and preserves anchor identity, internal accessibility, honest undetermined results, and distinct replay contracts.

obligations.invariant: Bubble semantics remain independent of TypeScript, Rust, storage encoding, host scheduling, and one physical machine while every optimized backend preserves exact lawful outcomes, provenance, resource-boundary honesty, and replay identity.
remainingLimits: The strict causal source profile now separates authored syntax from the typed runtime object, but TypeScript remains the only executable kernel and digests still depend on JavaScript stable serialization; no machine-independent BIR, canonical binary contract, engine ABI, compiled law form, differential backend suite, deterministic parallel contract, or Rust implementation exists.
obligations.reopenCondition: Remain open through late 5.x semantic-contract closure and the 6.x Rust transition; reopen for every backend, accelerator, distributed executor, nonstandard substrate, or optimization that could change world meaning or resource-boundary evidence.

obligations.invariant: A finite internal demand over an infinite Bubble returns one deterministic complete semantic result without exhausting infinity, selecting a lawful branch, importing an external observer, or confusing monotone evidence with monotone world state or guaranteed convergence.
remainingLimits: Finite demanded-cut certificates, complete plural result forms, explicit frontiers, dormant-constructor reactivation, inherited complete executable schema-graph revisions, a digest-linked realization-evidence ledger, and bounded exact active recurrence with lineage/revision/anchor identity and separated replay/commit history exist. Intensional schema/formal-family generation, constructor/schema-incidence transformation, topology-changing or non-periodic persistence, general convergence, branch equivalence, external observation semantics, non-effective denotation, and whole-universe completion remain open.
obligations.reopenCondition: Reopen whenever a finite demand, recurrence, observer, generated definition, backend, or branch quotient could discard a lawful frontier, fabricate determinacy, or claim more of infinity than its evidence proves.

sessionConstraints.rule: The v0.5.1 development session was required to leave its completion work uncommitted for author review.
v0.5.2 must preserve the pre-implementation philosophy and correct v0.5.1 by forward generalization rather than rewriting the pushed release.

All post-v0.5.6 work must derive from the author's recorded Bubble philosophy; an assistant-invented convenience, passing slice, or unselected candidate cannot replace open intent or select a release.
After the bounded membrane release, prioritize implementation of missing major author ideas over continued local tuning; v0.5.8 must be a large connected Phase 1 universe-generation change.

Do not make protagonist, story, life, being, relationship, or other human-scale observer categories into Bubble primitives, privileged emergence labels, release goals, or universal acceptance criteria.

Use the observer-free v0.4.7 necessity core as philosophical authority; preserve later observer-independent mathematics, quarantine explanatory human-scale modules from the public core, and require a recorded necessity argument before adding any new core primitive.
Treat v0.5.8 as a large connected semantic implementation, not a feature-count or version-click exercise; preserve every remaining limit and require author judgment before release confirmation.
